title: WPMS/3739/2019 of PREM CHAND GUPTA Vs MUSSOORIE DEHRADUN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY

paras.text:
WPMS No.3739 of 2019
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.

Mr. Siddhartha Singh, Advocate present for
the petitioner.
Mr. Rahul Consul, Advocate present for the
respondents.
The petitioner has evidently raised a
construction without prior approval or sanction of
the Development Authority i.e. Mussoorie
Dehradun Development Authority. The demolition
order was passed way back in the year 2012 on
14.05.2012 under Section 27 of the U.P. Urban
Planning and Development Act, 1973.
Admittedly the petitioner did not prefer any
appeal as provided against such order before the
Divisional Commissioner, who is also the ex
officio Chairman of the Development Authority. A
belated appeal was filed by the petitioner now in
the year 2019, which has now been dismissed on
ground of delay.
Petitioner, all the same, still has a remedy to
file revision before the State Government under
sub-section (4) of Section 7-B of the Uttarakhand
Urban and Country Planning and Development
Act, 1973. In case the petitioner files a revision, the
same shall be considered in accordance with law.
Writ petition is dismissed on ground of
alternative remedy.
Let a certified copy of this order be issued
today itself on payment of usual charges.
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
 07.12.2019
Avneet/
